phase_0.boundary_condition: The 18-dimensional phase space manifold constrained by total energy and angular momentum conservation.

VINIT.justification: The uninitialized 18-element array before mass injection or coordinate assignment.

TANCH.justification: The determinant of the flow Jacobian must equal unity to anchor the system within symplectic geometry.

AFWD.justification: A directed forward morphism in time using symplectic drift-kick-drift composition.

AREV.justification: A contravariant transformation that reverses the flow to benchmark numerical reversibility.

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition of integration steps with periodic determinant monitoring.

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-recognition of the system state through the invariance of total energy and angular momentum.

FSPLIT.justification: Bifurcation of absolute coordinates into a center-of-mass arm and a relative-motion arm.

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitution of absolute Cartesian coordinates from center-of-mass and relative vectors.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation of a stable trajectory on a KAM torus via rotation number variance.

EVALF.justification: Negative evaluation detecting chaotic divergence through variational shadow trajectories.

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice state where the orbit is held at the threshold of stability, exhibiting both order and chaos.

IFIX.justification: Permanent fixation of state crossings at a specific hyperplane, creating an irreversible geometric record.

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized 18D manifold with zeroed mass and momentum.
phase_3.true_description: Integrable regime characterized by stable, nested KAM tori.
phase_3.false_description: Chaotic regime characterized by positive Lyapunov exponents and ergodicity.
phase_3.both_description: KAM boundary state where stable islands and chaotic seas coexist simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Inject figure-8 initial conditions and calculate base energy.
Propagate system forward by one full figure-8 period.
Decompose absolute state into center-of-mass and relative Jacobi components.
Propagate center-of-mass arm analytically as a free particle.
Verify the relative arm remains within a quasi-periodic regime.
Further decompose relative arm into internal Keplerian sub-sectors.
Measure the Fast Lyapunov Indicator to detect early chaotic onset.
Reconstitute the relative arm from internal sub-sectors.
Execute momentum-flip to benchmark numerical reversibility error.
Reconstitute absolute Cartesian state from Jacobi components.
Apply out-of-plane perturbation to reach the KAM stability boundary.
Chain 10,000 symplectic steps with periodic Jacobian determinant checks.
Record state crossings at the y3=0 hyperplane to generate a Poincaré section.
Verify final energy and angular momentum against initial invariants.
Confirm Liouville closure by asserting det(J) equals one.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Forest-Ruth symplectic coefficient set (c, d) translating time steps into drift-kick operations.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Jacobi coordinate mapping between absolute and relative reference frames.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The 18-element NumPy ndarray storing positions and momenta.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The integration loop managing the sequence of symplectic sub-steps.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Chenciner-Montgomery figure-8 initial condition dataset.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Numerical precision loss per floating-point operation.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The symplectic nature of the integrator ensures energy drift is bounded and phase space volume is conserved.
